rules.text: Rewards follow the total length of all the fish you catch during the event.
Each prestige gives as many lures as your Fishing Line value.
The Tacklebox makes one lure every N minutes, N being its Speed value, and holds a base capacity plus its Size value. At Speed 0 it is full at every visit.
You can catch at most a base daily limit plus your Bucket value per day, counted in 24-hour blocks from now.
Fishing Skill unlocks the species whose required level is below its value; every unlocked species is equally likely.
A catch's length is drawn evenly between the species' smallest and largest length, then multiplied by the Fishing Hook value.
Rarity is drawn from the rarity table at your bait value plus one.
A catch gives the coins its rarity is worth in the game's XP table.
Levels start at 1; level L gives the L-th value of its list, and going from L to L+1 costs the L-th cost.
Lures you do not use stay in stock, with no limit.
In-game names are matched to the game data from the descriptions in Game Hive's post.
